why: No major reviewer or authority tests UGREEN Nexode Pro against Anker Prime; the only famous names are a Peak Design launch story (T3) and a UGREEN launch news post (Notebookcheck) with prices but no testing. Six of the results are one AI-templated spec article syndicated across different domains that explicitly declines to name a winner, plus retailer compare tables and an unreadable PDF. A page that pairs the lines tier by tier with current prices, measured port allocation, and a straight recommendation would stand out immediately.
